units: Gen. R. s. 5, beg. לא א׳ לא דיבור no (power of) speech or word; a. fr.—הא א׳ this is speech, i.e. this is right.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 4:5:2">Y. Snh. IV, 22ᵇ</cite> top; VI, beg. 23ᵇ.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 9:1:4">Y. B. Kam. IX, beg. 6ᵈ</cite> (contracted) <he>הא׳</he> same.

senses.gloss: the word amar (אמר) in the Scripture text.
units: Y. Snh. VII, 25ᵇ bot. נאמר כאן א׳ וכ׳ here amar is used &c.; as well as amar here indicates that the word is considered a deed &c.; a. e.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 1:6">Kidd. I, 6</cite> <he>אֲמִירָתוֹ לגבוה וכ׳</he> dedication to the Lord (by word of mouth) is equal to what delivery is in private transactions.—Pl. <he>אֲמִירוֹת</he> mostly in the sense of 2).
Num. R. s. 14, end א׳ וציוויים texts in which amar and tsivvah occur; a. fr.
